## 2 August 2022

## Circular to Intermediaries

## Reminder on End-To-End (E2E) Test for the Hong Kong Investor Identification Regime (HKIDR)

Reference is made to the Circular dated 17 June 2022 and 13 July 2022 regarding E2E Test for the HKIDR.

## Completion of E2E Test

Relevant Regulated Intermediaries 1  (RRIs) are reminded to complete the mandatory E2E Test for  the  HKIDR  on  or  before 5  August  2022 in  order  to  proceed  to  the  market  rehearsals following the successful completion of the E2E Test. Details of the MRs will be announced in due course.

RRIs  are  also  reminded  to  submit  (if  they  have  not  already  submitted)  the  E2E  Test confirmation reply forms (contained in the E2E Test package) upon completion of the E2E Test on or before 5 August 2022 to:

1. the  SFC  -  for  E2E  Test  on  the  submission  of  the  BCAN-CID  Mapping  File  and Reporting  Forms  to  Stock  Exchange  of  Hong  Kong's  (SEHK)  data  repository (applicable to all RRIs); and/or
2. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing Limited (HKEX) - for E2E Test on BCAN tagging for  order  submission  to  the  SEHK  trading  system  (applicable  to  RRIs  who  are Exchange Participants (EP) only).

The SFC E2E Test account will expire at 8:00 pm on 5 August 2022 and RRIs will not be able to use such account to log on to SEHK's E2E Test Electronic Communication Platform (ECP) web interface by then.

## Notification of using ECP Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Interface by non-EP RRIs

Separately, please note that the SFC will be performing system maintenance from 8 August 2022 to 12 August 2022. For Non-EP RRIs who intend to leverage on the ECP (SFTP) interface during the market rehearsals and after the launch of the HKIDR, the Responsible Officers of the relevant licensed corporations and Executive Officers of the relevant registered institutions can  submit  the  'ECP  User  Types  and  Delegated  Administrator  Rights  Application  / Maintenance Form' on SEHK's production ECP web interface via the SFC's WINGS platform with  their  individual  WINGS  accounts  starting  from 15 August 2022 ,  for  installing  HKEX's Securities and Derivatives Network (SDNet/2) production line. Please refer to HKEX's Circular dated 2 August 2022 for further details.

## Securities and Futures Commission

1  Relevant Regulated Intermediaries refer to SFC-licensed corporations and registered institutions subject to the HKIDR pursuant to paragraph 5.6 of the SFC's Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the SFC as set out in the Appendix C to the SFC's consultation conclusions paper issued in August 2021.
